findings.desc: Verification for CHK-001/CHK-002 does not cover the actual koala entrypoint the user runs. In this worktree, npm run test:gap-coverage-smoke and node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check both report 0 high gaps / 100% coverage, but koala gap_analyze and koala convergence_check still report 10 high gaps / 88% coverage. WHY: the stored evidence only proves the local dist/task path, so REVIEW cannot treat high-gap/coverage convergence as covered for the canonical koala command path. Severity: high because the checklist userSees promise is terminal-visible convergence output and the current koala command contradicts it.

koala-review-concept clean pass: implementation solves the user-visible convergence blocker by making canonical koala gap_analyze report 0 high / 100% after global link, and alias normalization is in the shared verificationIntent schema rather than a one-off adapter. No actionable concept finding.

koala-review-quality clean pass: schema alias handling is centralized with z.preprocess, invalid values still fail in smoke coverage, and gap_analyze still uses scanTruth as the denominator. No actionable quality finding.

koala-review-channel clean pass: code commits were authored by the implementer path, .omx was not touched, global koala was linked to the current build for user-entrypoint validation, and no open high/critical findings remain. No actionable channel finding.
koala-review-docs clean pass: this story did not change truth docs or user-facing documentation; remaining medium no_test gaps are explicitly reported and not hidden. No actionable docs finding.
